Anthropic-compatible Messages

Non-streaming Response

Response fields include usage.input_tokens, usage.output_tokens, usage.cache_creation_input_tokens, and usage.cache_read_input_tokens.

Streaming Response

The message_delta event contains Complete token usage: usage.input_tokens, usage.output_tokens, usage.cache_creation_input_tokens, and usage.cache_read_input_tokens. The following message_stop event marks the end of the stream.
